---
title: "Skills"
description: "Choose the skills Copilot follows while it builds your Rayfin app, see what each one teaches, and add custom skills for your own guidance."
---

Skills are `SKILL.md` instructions GitHub Copilot can read while it builds your Rayfin app. They teach the agent app-building patterns, design preferences, data-model rules, analytics workflows, and your own team conventions.

Rayfin keeps its core skills always on. New Universal App projects also include app-building skills in the project. You can turn on Fabricator's built-in skills and your own custom skills from the **Skills** tab.

![The Skills view: always-on Rayfin skills, built-in skills grouped into Look & feel, Experience, Data and Quality with on and off switches, and the details of the selected Secure by default skill, including when Copilot uses it and what it teaches.](/screenshots/skills.webp)

## Open the Skills tab

1. Open a project.
2. In the app bar, select **Code**.
3. In the code view's segmented control, select **Skills**.

Skills are grouped into sections:

| Section | What's in it |
| --- | --- |
| **Always on** | Core guidance managed by Rayfin. The Rayfin CLI installs and updates these skills, and you can't turn them off. |
| **Look & feel**, **Experience**, **Data**, **Quality** | Fabricator's built-in skills. Turn on the ones you want for this app. |
| **Your skill library** | Custom skills you saved to reuse in any app. |
| **Added in this app** | Skills that live only in this app, such as the ones its template came with. |

To find a skill, type in **Search skills**. To see only the skills this app uses, or only the ones it doesn't, select **On** or **Off**.

## Turn a skill on or off

On a skill's card, select its switch. Fabricator adds the skill's `SKILL.md` to the app's `.agents/skills/<skill id>/` folder, or removes it, and saves the change to git history. Copilot follows the skill from your next message.

Skills in **Added in this app** don't have a switch, because removing one deletes it from the app. Select the skill, then select **Remove**. If you want to keep using it in other apps, select **Save to library** first, when the skill offers it.

## See what a skill teaches

Select a skill's card to open its details next to the grid:

- **When Copilot uses it** describes the requests the skill is meant for, and lists its trigger words.
- **What it teaches** shows the skill's guidance.
- **File** shows where the skill lives in the app.
- **View SKILL.md** opens the raw file, including its frontmatter.

When nothing is selected, the side panel explains **How skills work** and counts the skills in this app. To close a skill's details, press Esc or select the close button.

## Built-in skills

| Skill | What it helps Copilot do |
| --- | --- |
| **Polished, modern UI** | Keep spacing, type, color and components consistent, in light and dark themes. |
| **Buttery animations** | Add short, purposeful motion that respects reduced-motion settings. |
| **Responsive on every screen** | Build layouts that work from phones to wide desktops. |
| **Easy navigation** | Give the app clear menus, page titles and URLs you can share. |
| **Clear, friendly wording** | Write plain, consistent labels, buttons, messages and empty states. |
| **Loading & empty states** | Handle loading, empty, error and success states for every view that loads or saves data. |
| **Friendly forms & validation** | Build forms that check input early, explain how to fix it and never lose what people typed. |
| **Solid data modeling** | Shape Rayfin entities, relationships and queries, and page through long lists. |
| **Search, sort & filter** | Help people find records in long lists, with filtering done in the query. |
| **Beautiful charts & dashboards** | Pick the right chart for each question and lead with the key numbers. |
| **Accessible to everyone** | Make the app work with a keyboard and screen readers, with readable contrast. |
| **Secure by default** | Protect data with row-level rules, require sign-in for personal data and keep secrets out of the browser. |
| **Fast & snappy** | Keep the app quick to load and smooth to use as data grows. |

If the app or your skill library already has its own skill with the same name as a built-in skill, such as the Universal App's `data-modeling`, the Skills tab shows that skill instead of the built-in one. A skill in **Added in this app** that shares a built-in skill's name can't be saved to your library.

## Update a built-in skill

When a newer version of a built-in skill is available, its card shows **Update available**. To update it, select the skill, then select **Update**. To update every built-in skill that has a newer version, clear the selection and use the **Updates** section of the side panel.

Updating replaces the app's copy of the skill and saves the change to git history.

## Built-in project skills at a glance

The Universal App starter ships with skills that route common Rayfin app requests:

| Skill | What it helps Copilot do |
| --- | --- |
| `capability-router` | Choose the smallest needed capability packs before changing code. |
| `rayfin-web-docs` | Look up official Rayfin documentation for version-aware Rayfin API work. |
| `authentication` | Wire the existing Fabric sign-in scaffolding for protected pages and per-user data. |
| `data-modeling` | Add Rayfin entities, schema registration, typed client reads and writes, and row-level security patterns. |
| `graphein-visuals` | Build charts, KPIs, tables and dashboards with Graphein specs over app data. |
| `analytics` | Turn on the Power BI or Fabric semantic-model dashboard pack. |
| `build-workflow` | Build analytics dashboards in small loops: one hero visual, preview, then breadth and polish. |
| `fabric-data` | Add and query Fabric semantic model connections with `fabric-app-data`. |
| `dax` | Discover semantic model schema and write DAX queries at the visual grain. |
| `visuals` | Author analytics dashboard visuals, KPI cards, tables, slicers and chart specs. |
| `headless-preview` | Validate visuals with `npm run preview` and a PNG/report loop. |
| `app-design` | Make dashboard layout, typography, tokens, states and visual polish cohesive. |

These skills are project files, so they travel with the app. They appear in **Added in this app**. Fabricator also injects Fabricator-specific operating instructions during chat, such as not running `rayfin up` because Fabricator deploys after a turn.

## Add a custom skill

Use a custom skill for guidance that is specific to your organization, brand, data vocabulary, or review checklist.

1. Open **Skills**.
2. Select **New skill**.
3. Choose **Write** to author one in Fabricator, or **Upload** to bring in an existing skill.
4. Give it a **Title**, optional **Icon**, and **Short description**.
5. Write the **Skill instructions (SKILL.md)**. The file must start with YAML frontmatter that includes `name` and `description`.
6. Decide whether to turn on **Save to my skill library**.
7. Select **Add skill**.

A skill's frontmatter `description` tells Copilot when to use it. The body tells Copilot what to do.

## Upload a custom skill

The **Upload** tab accepts a folder, a Markdown file, or a `.zip` that contains `SKILL.md`. If the skill has `references/*.md` files, Fabricator brings those along too.

Fabricator previews the skill before adding it. Review the preview, then select **Add skill**.

## Project skills and the skill library

Custom skills have two scopes:

- The app copy lives in the project under `.agents/skills/<id>/`. Apps that already use a skill keep their copy.
- Reusable skills are listed under **Your skill library** and stored once in Fabricator's app data under `custom-skills/<id>/`. Turn a library skill on to copy it into the current app.

To make a skill from **Added in this app** reusable in other apps, select it, then select **Save to library**.

## Edit or delete a library skill

Select a library skill to see **Edit** and **Delete** in its details.

- **Edit** opens **Edit custom skill**, where you can change the card details and `SKILL.md`.
- **Delete** removes the skill from your reusable library.

Deleting a library skill does not remove copies that are already active in apps. Turn the skill off in each app's **Skills** tab if you no longer want Copilot to use it there.
